about: Votes cast in each territory's 2024 delegate or resident commissioner race and its registered voters, sizing a delegate race the town does not vote in. Votes: certified results as reproduced on Wikipedia (DC Board of Elections, Guam Election Commission, American Samoa Election Office, CNMI Commonwealth Election Commission, Puerto Rico); registered voters: EAC 2024 Election Administration and Voting Survey, item A1a. The Virgin Islands total is derived from a vote share (plus or minus 100). Registered voters stand in for eligible citizens (an underestimate), marked ESTIMATED.
